investigator.method: Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC only: plain curl GET (descriptive User-Agent, no authentication, no browser) of the venue's own official club events page and one individual event detail page. The site is Webflow, with its event list server-side-rendered (SSR) directly into the initial HTML as a Webflow CMS Collection List (Finsweet cmsfilter/cmsload attributes only add client-side filter/sort UI on top of already-rendered items — the events themselves are present without any JS execution).

probe_history.reason: The public club events page (https://cassiopeia-berlin.de/club) is a Webflow site whose event list is server-side-rendered directly into the initial HTML: 8 sampled event cards, each with its own title, day/month digits plus a full 'Month YYYY' text within the same per-event date block, a start ('Beginn') time, a category/genre tag, and a link to the event's own detail page. This directly answers the investigation question without needing to escalate. No JSON-LD Event/MusicEvent schema, ICS feed, WordPress plugin, Fourvenues widget, or Sanity CMS was found.

venue_reference: Cassiopeia (club and concert venue, Revaler Str. 99, RAW-Gelände, Berlin-Friedrichshain, operating since 2005)

identity.notes: Official identity confirmed directly from the retained evidence: the venue's own domain (cassiopeia-berlin.de), its own <title> ('Cassiopeia Berlin – Club'), its own meta description stating 'Seit 2005 pulsiert das Cassiopeia als Club und Konzertlocation auf dem R.A.W. Gelände in Berlin Friedrichshain', and the Webflow data-wf-domain attribute matching the same domain. Discovered via WebSearch (not treated as authority itself) and independently confirmed by fetching the domain directly.

site_classification.platform: Webflow (data-wf-domain/data-wf-site attributes; cdn.prod.website-files.com assets), with a Webflow CMS Collection List for events server-side-rendered into the page; Finsweet cmsfilter/cmsload/cmsselect attributes add client-side month/search filtering on top of the already-rendered list, not a separate API.

title.notes: Each event card's own <h2 fs-cmsfilter-field="title" class="subheading event"> states the full title directly. Sampled representative value from the first card on the retained page; the same structure repeats identically across all 8 sampled cards.

start_date.notes: Each event's own date block (event-date-wrapper) states the day and numeric month as adjacent digit nodes ('28', '.', '08', '.') AND, within that SAME per-event block (not a distant page-level heading shared across many unrelated events), a sibling hidden filter node states the full 'Month YYYY' in words (fs-cmsfilter-field="date" class="event-date faker">August 2026). Both pieces belong to this one event's own markup; combining them mechanically (day + numeric month, cross-checked against the month name in the faker text, + the year from the faker text) yields exactly one result, 2026-08-28. This is recorded as DETERMINISTIC_CONTEXT rather than DIRECT_SOURCE because the exact combined date string is not present as a single token anywhere — it genuinely requires combining >=2 retained sibling nodes, even though both belong to the same event record.

derivation.rule: Within one event's own <div class="event-date-wrapper">, concatenate the digit nodes ('28' + '08') as <DD>.<MM>, then take the year from the sibling <h2 fs-cmsfilter-field="date" class="event-date faker"> node's 'Month YYYY' text (cross-checking that its month name matches the numeric month already read) to yield <Year>-<MM>-<DD>. Exactly one result per event; no page-level heading or cross-event inheritance is involved.
inputs: August 2026 (sibling faker node's month-name + year text, same event-date-wrapper)

time.notes: Each card's own event-detail block states a 'Beginn' (start) time directly (e.g. '19:15' on the sampled card, alongside a separate 'Einlass'/doors time '18:30'), but with no UTC offset or explicit timezone anywhere on the page — a floating local time only, not a confirmed instant. Consistent with this project's v1.2 worked example (example-deterministic-context-ready-01), a floating local time is retained honestly as PARTIAL rather than promoted to a precise PROVEN value.

end.notes: No end date/time is stated anywhere on the event card or the sampled event detail page.

venue_location.notes: Not stated per-event-card as a discrete field. This source represents exactly one physical venue (Cassiopeia, Revaler Str. 99) — consistent with this project's existing single-venue-per-source precedent (e.g. razzmatazz-barcelona-01), venue identity is intended to resolve via source_id at activation time, not by parsing a per-record field the source does not actually expose.

source_record_id.notes: Each event card's own detail-page link ('/event/{slug}') carries a Webflow CMS-style slug ending in a distinct numeric suffix (e.g. '-111685127') that reads as this platform's own auto-generated per-item identifier appended to the human title-slug — used here as the stable identifier, matching this project's existing LAV/moog-barcelona-01/badehaus-berlin-01/urban-spree-berlin-01 URL-slug precedent. Stability of the numeric suffix specifically (as opposed to just the whole slug) was not independently re-fetched to confirm it never changes; the WHOLE slug (title-text + numeric suffix) is what is actually proposed as source_record_id, and that whole string is directly read from the source's own link markup, not inferred.

event_url.notes: Each event card's own <a href="/event/{slug}"> states the relative path directly; resolved against the page's own domain and confirmed to return the matching event's own detail page (evidence/event-detail.html).

price.notes: No price text appears on any sampled event card or on the sampled event detail page (checked directly, including common German price markers 'VVK'/'AK' and euro-amount patterns — none found).

reasons: Identity PROVEN directly from retained evidence.
acquisition_class STATIC_HTML, a resolved supported class, with a CONFIRMED public data path (8 real, current event cards SSR'd on the live page).

title PROVEN with basis DIRECT_SOURCE; start_date PROVEN with basis DETERMINISTIC_CONTEXT, mechanically combining two sibling nodes within the SAME per-event record (not cross-event inheritance) — a genuine, reproducible combination, not a guess.
source_record_id PROVEN via a documented URL-slug strategy, matching this project's existing precedent from other investigated Berlin/Barcelona sources.
recommended_family STATIC_EVENT_LIST, an existing named family in this project's collector-family vocabulary.

Decision intentionally stops at READY_FOR_OFFLINE_PROOF, not READY_FOR_ACTIVATION: this investigation retains no DETERMINISTIC_DERIVATION evidence item (no collector/parser code or offline fixture reproduction was written in this task), which gate 9 (and, for the DETERMINISTIC_CONTEXT start_date field specifically, the v1.2 field-specific refinement of gate 9) requires. Building and offline-proving the STATIC_EVENT_LIST parser — including the date-combination rule above — against the retained evidence/club-page.html fixture is separate, explicitly follow-up work.
